_comment: One per mod: copy next to the mod, e.g. <mod>/3d/forge.json. Relative paths are relative to THIS file;
%VARS% expand (e.g. %USERPROFILE%). Empty blender / dayz_tools_bin / p_drive_real are detected:
blender on PATH or Program Files/Blender Foundation; DayZ Tools in your Steam libraries; P: from 'subst'.
rig_blend and the two bodies are NOT shipped with the tool (licenses): see README, 'What you must provide'.
pbo_path: leave empty to derive it from the $PBOPREFIX$ above data_dir.
Check everything without building: python build_vest.py --config <this file> --check-config
